name: MMLongBench
intro: MMLongBench是首个涵盖多种长上下文视觉-语言任务的基准，旨在有效且全面地评估长上下文视觉-语言模型（LCVLMs）。它包含13,331个示例，涵盖五种不同类别的下游任务，如视觉RAG和多样本ICL。该基准通过提供广泛的任务覆盖、多样的图像类型和严格的长度控制，为诊断和推进下一代LCVLMs提供了基础。
org: Zhaowei Wang, Wenhao Yu, Xiyu Ren, Jipeng Zhang, Yu Zhao, Rohit Saxena, Liang Cheng, Ginny Wong, Sim
build_method: 16个现有数据集改造, 跨模态长度控制, 混合构建
task_type: 视觉RAG, NIAH, 多样本ICL, PDF摘要, 长文档问答
eval_feature: 长上下文, 多模态, 跨模态
scale: 13,331个示例，16个数据集，五类任务，五档长度
build_method_en: Adaptation of 16 Existing Datasets, Cross-modal Length Control, Hybrid
intro_en: MMLongBench is the first benchmark covering various long-context vision-language tasks, designed to effectively and comprehensively evaluate long-context vision-language models (LCVLMs). It includes 13,331 examples across five different downstream task categories, such as visual RAG and multi-sample ICL. By offering broad task coverage, diverse image types, and strict length control, this benchmark provides a foundation for diagnosing and advancing the next generation of LCVLMs.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2505.10610 Sections 3-4 and Appendices B-C plus the EdinburghNLP/MMLongBench repository. The diagram preserves 13,331 examples drawn from 16 existing datasets without new crowdsourcing; the five Visual RAG, NIAH, Many-shot ICL, PDF summarization, and Long-document VQA categories; category-specific construction including 100-word Wikipedia passages, mixed needles, balanced exemplars with random integer labels, atomic summary claims, and answer-page preservation; unified image-patch pixel-unshuffle plus text token counting; exact 8K/16K/32K/64K/128K inputs; evaluation of 46 models on 4,050 examples at each of five lengths for 20,250 instances; and task-appropriate Accuracy, Substring Exact Match, and GPT-4o Fluency-F1 reporting.
